Strategy, portfolio and projects · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

Goal cascade review

Thiago · Strategic Planning Analyst

A software company with 14 areas cascades 5 strategic objectives into about 90 area objectives and 280 key results per quarter.

When it runs
When the OKR submission window closes each quarter and the planning team freezes the cascading spreadsheet, 4 business days before the validation meeting with leadership
What it delivers in production
The planning manager receives, on the first day of the submission window, an opinion column per key result and the list of contradictions between areas; after approval, leaders have 2 days to fix.
Who decides
Flags and proposes opinions; the manager approves
Effort
Calibrate on the previous quarter; half a day
Set up5 steps · 6 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

# OKR writing guide and review rules

## Shape of the key result
Every KR has: a catalog metric (metric column), a numeric baseline, a numeric target and a deadline (date). Each missing item generates the verdict NO METRIC, NO BASELINE, NO TARGET or NO DEADLINE. A filled-in metric that is not in the catalog is NO METRIC.

## Link
The area objective points to one of the strategic objectives (strategic_objective column). The parent_metric of the KR's metric must be the parent metric of that objective. Otherwise: NO LINK. A KR with NO METRIC does not get NO LINK because of the metric.

## Coherence across areas
- DUPLICATE: KRs from different areas with the same metric and the same direction (both go up or both go down).
- CONTRADICTION: KRs from different areas with the same metric in opposite directions.
- Direction = target greater than the baseline (up) or lower (down).
- Metrics linked in the hierarchy: one is the parent_metric of the other in the catalog. Sibling metrics (same parent) are not grouped.

## History
The id stays the same when the KR repeats. REPEATED WITHOUT ADJUSTMENT: the id appears in the last two quarters of the history with attainment below 50% in both.

## Missing id
Generate PROV-01, PROV-02... in spreadsheet order and flag it.

## Budget of the area objectives (for the escalation)
| Area objective | Budget |
|---|---|
| Replace the finance ERP | R$ 2,400,000 |
| Speed up acquisition | R$ 900,000 |
| All others | below R$ 500,000 |

## Rules with no leeway
- Each KR gets every verdict that applies to it (NO METRIC, NO BASELINE and NO TARGET together, for example). A KR with no verdict is OK and goes only into the summary, with no comment.
- DUPLICATE and CONTRADICTION flag both KRs of the pair, each on its own line, citing the other's id.
- Sibling metrics (same parent_metric, such as qualified_leads and new_arr) do not form DUPLICATE or CONTRADICTION.
- An area objective without strategic_objective is NO LINK, even with a catalog metric. An objective outside the budget table counts as "below R$ 500,000".
- Summary: total KRs, how many OK and how many with a verdict (each KR counts once). Separately, the count by type, where a KR counts in each type it received.
- When a KR falls into more than one band, all apply: shape goes to the manager's batch; CONTRADICTION and NO LINK above R$ 1 million go to individual approval. Nothing is sent to the leaders in this round.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear in any part of the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI never changes the text or target of a key result: it writes its opinion in a dedicated column, because the target is the leader's commitment to leadership and a rewrite by someone else empties the accountability. An opinion on a contradiction between areas only goes out after the planning manager reads it, because pointing out that two directors are promising incompatible things requires context the spreadsheet does not have. The agent does not judge whether a target is ambitious or easy; it checks form, link and coherence across areas.

Common mistakes

  • Treating a contribution target and a consolidated target on the same metric as a duplicate; the catalog needs to mark the hierarchy.
  • Requiring a numeric metric in an area objective, which is qualitative by definition; the numeric criterion applies to the key result.
  • Accepting pasted objective text as a link, without the key result's metric contributing to the parent metric.
  • Flagging contradictions only by metric name and missing different metrics that move together (lead volume and cost per lead).

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Items fixed live in the validation meetingfrom more than 20 per cycle to fewer than 5estimate based on the described routine
Reading coverage of the cascade before the meetingfrom about 50% of items to 100%process target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine)
Recovery of the previous cycle's issues in calibration90% or more, with at most 10 unwarranted flagsestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Review of the Q4 2026 cascade, spreadsheet frozen on 2026-09-15. Items read: 92 area objectives, 284 key results.

KR-Mkt-03 | Increase qualified leads from 1,200 to 1,560 per month by Dec 2026 | Opinion: OK, catalog metric, baseline and target present | Link: SO2 revenue growth
KR-Sls-07 | Reduce customer acquisition cost by 50% by Dec 2026 | Opinion: CONTRADICTION with KR-Mkt-03; both use cost per lead as a component, incompatible directions in the same quarter | Action: meeting between the marketing and sales leaders
KR-Prod-12 | Improve the onboarding experience | Opinion: NO METRIC, no baseline, no numeric target | Action: rewrite with a catalog metric (suggestions: time to first value, 7-day activation)
KR-CS-04 | Reduce churn from 3.1% to 2.4% monthly | Opinion: OK | Note: duplicates the metric in KR-Sls-11 (same metric, same direction, different targets 2.4% and 2.6%); unify the owner
AO-Leg-02 | Implement a new contract management system | Opinion: NO LINK to a strategic objective | Action: link it or classify it as an operational project outside the cascade

Summary: 284 KRs, 231 OK, 19 without metric or target, 9 duplicates, 4 contradictions between areas, 3 objectives without a link. Opinions awaiting the planning manager's approval before sending.
